verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's OpenAI-compatible API implies standard SSE streaming support since it's a drop-in replacement for OpenAI SDK (which supports streaming), and priority tier docs reference time-to-first-token metrics relevant to streaming responsiveness, but no evidence explicitly documents a `stream: true` parameter or SSE token-by-token behavior. missing for 10: explicit documentation of stream parameter/SSE format, hands-on confirmation of token-by-token streaming, and any independent benchmark of streaming latency.
